slug: 2026-02-04 Sudatel-Djibouti Telecom-Ethio telecom launch Horizon Fiber cross-border initiative (SUNA)

facts.fact: SUNA, the Sudanese state news agency, reports Sudatel signed a strategic agreement with Djibouti Telecom and Ethio telecom on 4 February 2026 launching Horizon Fiber, a terrestrial fibre corridor linking Djibouti's international submarine cable stations through Ethiopia to Sudan.
